Subject: Administrative scrutiny of 7A/7B/14B cases-Reg

Sir/Madam,

Please refer to HO guidelines dated 17.10.2007 cited above on
administrative arrangements for exercise of powers and supervisory test check of
final orders passed u/s 7A/14B & 7B whereby the following instructions were issued
for compliance:

(i) Exercise of statutory powers u/s 7B: The jurisdiction shall be exercised by the
Officer concerned only after obtaining the views of officer next in hierarchy viz. APFC,
RO / DO to obtain view of RPFC-II(Compliance), RO or RPFC-|, RO (in case RPFC-II
's not in the hierarchy); RPFC-Il, RO to obtain view of RPFC-I, RO or Zonal Addl.
CPFC (in case it is RO headed by RPFC-II) and RPFC-I, RO to obtain view of Zonal
Addl. CPFC

(i) Administrative scrutiny of Orders issued u/s 7A/14B: That the RPFC-Il/ RPFC-|
should carry out supervisory test check of 7A /14B orders passed by the
APFC/RPFC-II as the case may be every month and intimate his remarks

comments to the concerned assessing officer under intimation to RPFC-I / ACC of
the Zor Such check should be done every month in r/o all cases initiated on

complaints referred by VIP / HO / Vigilance / Trade Unions: cases closed without
actual assessment of dues and reduction of assessed amount through review under
Section 7B and 10% of cases other than above. Similar exercise may be done by
ACC (Zone) at random, in r/o assessment orders passed by APFC / RPFC-I| / RPFC-

|

File No.C-l/(104)2017/SAHARAINDIA

(i) Follow up action on observations made during test check: If the administrative
authority during the test check feels necessary that the matter needs to be relooked
into, directions for invoking the jurisdiction under Sec. 7B / 7C should be issued
Further, if it is found that any decision made in 7A / 7B by the assessing officer in not
as per law and against the interest of EPFO, provisions of Sec. 7-I should be
invoked

2 All ACCs (ZO) are requested to furnish the information of test-checks of
7A/14B orders conducted by Zonal ACC and RPFC-I/RPFC-Il during the last two
years, that is, 2019-20 and 2020-21 in the ZOs and ROs under their jurisdiction in
compliance of HO guidelines dated 17.10.2007.

3 Further, all ACCs (ZO) are also requested to conduct test-checks on all
7B cases during the last three years, that is 2019-20 and 2020-21 in the ZOs and
ROs under their jurisdiction and examine w.r.t.:

a. whether complying with respect to the procedure laid down vide HO direction
dated 17.10.2007

b. whether opened within the period stipulated under Para 79A of the Scheme;
and

c. all such cases where the amount assessed in original order passed is reduced
in assessment after re-opening the matter u/s 7B.

4 The report in the format enclosed should be furnished by 31.08.2021 for
the last two years along with the report for the first quarter of 2021-22. If nothing is
received HO will proceed further presuming NIL report

Moreover, the report for the quarter ending June, September, December and March
of an year (2021-22 onwards) should be furnished by the last working day of July,
October, January and April, respectively, without fail.

Yours faithfully,
